title: The kb-sprint run step waits with coord.py wait, names the run states each tool moves and lands in a landing worktree, in the skill and its clone copy
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md, which the clone's .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md links to, carries one run step that waits for a worker, a gate or a landing with one `coord.py wait --kind progress --item IDS` command and names no pid check or wakeup that checks a pid; the run step reads a worker's open blocking gates from the `gates` of its `blocked` event as the worker posts them, not from its branch after it returns; the run step names the run state each tool moves (claim, dispatch, gate add, stage-back, land) with `coord.py transition` for a repair only, then `backlog.py runs SP` showing no drift at the sprint's end; the run step says `land` works in a landing worktree of its own, so no step asks for an orchestrator checkout that shows only its own changes

run:
import re, sys
P = ['skills/sprint/SKILL.md', '.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md']
T = [open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() for p in P]
bad = []
if T[0] != T[1]:
    bad.append('the two copies differ')
m = re.search(r'\n## run \[SP\]\n(.*?)\n## review SP\n', T[0], re.S)
run = m.group(1) if m else ''
if not run:
    bad.append('the skill has no run section')
if not re.search(r'coord\.py wait\b[^`\n]*--kind progress\b[^`\n]*--item\b', run):
    bad.append('the run step names no coord.py wait --kind progress --item command')
for phrase in ('checks the pid', 'kill -0', 'ps -p', 'Wait on the pid', 'wait on the pid'):
    if phrase in run:
        bad.append('the run step still says: ' + phrase)
print('; '.join(bad) or 'ok')
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import json, os, re, shlex, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading, time
R = os.getcwd()
S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
text = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
m = re.search(r'\n## run \[SP\]\n(.*?)\n## review SP\n', text, re.S)
run = m.group(1) if m else ''
cmds = [c for c in re.findall(r'`([^`\n]+)`', run) if 'coord.py wait' in c and '--kind progress' in c and '--item' in c]
if not cmds:
    print('the run step gives no coord.py wait --kind progress --item command')
    sys.exit(1)
if not re.search(r'blocked[^\n]{0,300}gates|gates[^\n]{0,300}blocked', run):
    print('the run step does not say that a blocked event carries the item\'s open gates')
    sys.exit(1)
iid = 'ST-aaaaaaaa'
argv = shlex.split(cmds[0].replace('${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}', R))
at = next(i for i, a in enumerate(argv) if a.endswith('coord.py'))
argv[at + 1:at + 1] = ['--store', S]
def form(since):
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a in ('--since', '--timeout', '--item') and i + 1 < len(argv):
            out += [a, {'--since': str(since), '--timeout': '20', '--item': iid}[a]]
            i += 2
        else:
            out.append(a)
            i += 1
    return out
def moves():
    time.sleep(1.5)
    for state, extra in (('claimed', []), ('working', []), ('blocked', ['--field', 'gates=g1'])):
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, 'transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', state] + extra,
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
        time.sleep(0.3)
threading.Thread(target=moves, daemon=True).start()
last, seen, deadline = 0, [], time.time() + 25
while time.time() < deadline and not any(e['fields'].get('state') == 'blocked' for e in seen):
    r = subprocess.run(form(last), capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print('the wait command exited', r.returncode, r.stderr[-200:])
        sys.exit(1)
    got = json.loads(r.stdout)
    seen += got['events']
    last = got['last']
blocked = [e for e in seen if e['fields'].get('state') == 'blocked']
print('states seen', [e['fields'].get('state') for e in seen], 'blocked gates', [e['fields'].get('gates') for e in blocked])
sys.exit(0 if blocked and blocked[0]['fields'].get('gates') == 'g1' else 1)

import os, re, shlex, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd()
text = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
other = open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
m = re.search(r'\n## run \[SP\]\n(.*?)\n## review SP\n', text, re.S)
run = m.group(1) if m else ''
bad = []
if text != other:
    bad.append('the two copies differ')
missing = [s for s in ('claimed', 'working', 'returned', 'failed', 'blocked', 'staging', 'landing', 'landed', 'refused')
           if not re.search(r'\b' + s + r'\b', run)]
if missing:
    bad.append('the run step names no run state ' + ', '.join(missing))
if 'coord.py transition' not in run:
    bad.append('the run step does not name coord.py transition')
cmds = [c for c in re.findall(r'`([^`\n]+)`', run) if re.search(r'backlog\.py runs\b', c)]
if not cmds:
    bad.append('the run step gives no backlog.py runs command')
else:
    T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
    env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
    def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
    g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
    shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
    sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, 'new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
    argv = shlex.split(cmds[0].replace('${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}', R))
    at = next(i for i, a in enumerate(argv) if a.endswith('backlog.py'))
    argv[at + 1:at + 1] = ['--root', T]
    argv = [sp if a == 'SP' else a for a in argv]
    r = sh(*argv)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        bad.append('the backlog.py runs command of the run step exits %d: %s' % (r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-200:]))
print('; '.join(bad) or 'ok')
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import re, sys
bad = []
for p in ('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', '.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md'):
    text = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
    m = re.search(r'\n## run \[SP\]\n(.*?)\n## review SP\n', text, re.S)
    run = m.group(1) if m else ''
    if 'landing worktree' not in run:
        bad.append(p + ': the run step does not name the landing worktree')
    if 'shows only your own changes' in run:
        bad.append(p + ': the run step still asks for a checkout that shows only the orchestrator\'s own changes')
doc = open('kb/_self/backlog.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
if re.search(r'lands them one at a time[^\n]{0,200}shows only your own changes', doc):
    bad.append('kb/_self/backlog.md still has the landing wait for the checkout to show only the orchestrator\'s own changes')
print('; '.join(bad) or 'ok')
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Premise: today's run step (skills/sprint/SKILL.md step 3) tells the orchestrator to wait for a dispatched worker with a background command that ends when its pid does or a scheduled wakeup that checks the pid, reads a worker's gates on its branch after it returns (step 4.1), and asks `git status --short` to show only its own changes before each landing (step 4.2) although `land` works in a landing worktree of its own; the run step names no `coord.py wait --kind progress --item`, no `blocked`/`returned` state and no `backlog.py runs`. Check 0 prints these on base. Plan 2026-10-24 (night run): .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md is a symlink to skills/sprint/SKILL.md (one file, not a protected path), so touches name the one file and no staging copy is needed. Checks 1 and 2 run the command forms the rule text gives (a wait loop over a planted store that sees `blocked` with `gates=g1`; `backlog.py runs SP` on a planted sprint), so the new text gives them in backticks with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} for the path, SEQ, S and IDS after --since, --timeout and --item, and SP for the sprint. A wait that times out (timed_out true) is read as no move yet: the loop then reads `backlog.py runs SP` and `stalled` before waiting again. Provisional gates do not move the run state, so they are still read on the branch before a landing. The doc line of kb/_self/backlog.md that has the landing after `git status --short` shows only the orchestrator's own changes follows the skill (check 3).
